status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Move image controls to the left, reduce previews on the right, add browser-saved presets, and add click-to-apply rotation controls.
assumptions: A preset stores sticker colors, notation, input mode, label visibility, and selected palette color in localStorage.
Clicking a rotation button appends that move to the notation and immediately refreshes both previews.
Clockwise, counterclockwise, and double-turn controls are provided for each supported face move.

tasks.title: Add click-to-apply rotation symbols
tasks.summary: Render supported move buttons and apply a clicked move immediately.
verify: All supported face moves expose clockwise, inverse, and double-turn buttons.
A click updates notation and preview state.

tasks.title: Add local preset save, load, and delete
tasks.summary: Store and restore the current image configuration in the browser.
verify: Preset data is validated before use.
